title: South Korea deploys 5-satellite reconnaissance system
snippet: UPI April 28, 2026 — South Korea has completed deployment of its five-satellite reconnaissance system, comprising SAR and electro-optical satellites. System enables near-real-time surveillance of Korean Peninsula with multiple daily revisit capability. Part of ROK military space capability buildup.
tag_reason: New event; South Korea 5-satellite military reconnaissance constellation deployment — Korea GeoFocus.
